title: Earth-Keeper Families and Shared Underworld

sections.title: AZA'RA | THE EARTH-KEEPER FAMILIES AND SHARED UNDERWORLD
sections.text:
AZA'RA | THE EARTH-KEEPER FAMILIES AND SHARED UNDERWORLD
CANON ADDENDUM | 11 OCTOBER 2026

sections.title: The Cataclysm of 1351 BCE broke Uxrowo's sun harvesting and bound Earth and Aza'ra to one shared underworld. The mortal world and the u
sections.text: The Cataclysm of 1351 BCE broke Uxrowo's sun harvesting and bound Earth and Aza'ra to one shared underworld. The mortal world and the underworld are distinct spaces: ordinary portals connect living places, while the passage of souls answers to its own protections and laws.

sections.title: After the Cataclysm, Aza'raan families maintained contact with Earth as a matter of conscience. Their work grew across generations, and
sections.text: After the Cataclysm, Aza'raan families maintained contact with Earth as a matter of conscience. Their work grew across generations, and individual branches became skilled in medicine, science, archival protection, engineering and Earth cultural research. Exact founding dates and family names remain unstated until established in the manuscripts.

sections.title: Whole Aza'raan families dedicate successive generations to traveling to Earth. They do this from grief and guilt over the magic taken f
sections.text: Whole Aza'raan families dedicate successive generations to traveling to Earth. They do this from grief and guilt over the magic taken from Earth and the hardship humans face developing medicine, transportation, communications and institutions without the resources available on Aza'ra. They do not see humans as less intelligent. They believe the imbalance between the worlds created an obligation to help, not a license to rule.

sections.title: Their extended households protect research continuity. Children who later volunteer for Earth service study languages, etiquette, histo
sections.text: Their extended households protect research continuity. Children who later volunteer for Earth service study languages, etiquette, historical periods, scientific practice and social customs before participating. Family knowledge includes failures as well as achievements, allowing each generation to avoid repeating harmful interventions.

sections.title: Earth-based members appear as archaeologists, scientists, physicians, researchers, professors, librarians, engineers and historians. Th
sections.text: Earth-based members appear as archaeologists, scientists, physicians, researchers, professors, librarians, engineers and historians. They use carefully maintained human identities and documentation while traveling through portals. These are fictional covert-history details; the books need not provide instructions for producing false identification.

sections.title: 03. MIXED HERITAGE AND PASSING AS HUMAN
sections.text: 03. MIXED HERITAGE AND PASSING AS HUMAN

sections.title: A number of Earth-facing families intentionally form partnerships and raise children with Gandirosha, Deorbasun and Zirramunis peoples.
sections.text: A number of Earth-facing families intentionally form partnerships and raise children with Gandirosha, Deorbasun and Zirramunis peoples. Over generations, these ancestries can reduce readily identifiable Aza'raan features and help family members live among humans without attracting attention. Heritage does not guarantee one body shape, ear type or level of magical ability; every individual varies.

sections.title: This expands, but does not replace, the already approved protector-bloodline history: Pix's mother, Jacob and Clarahmizah have human-lo
sections.text: This expands, but does not replace, the already approved protector-bloodline history: Pix's mother, Jacob and Clarahmizah have human-looking ears, while Pix and his father retain the long, distinctive backward-swept points. Pix's childhood name came from those visible ears. His mother later acknowledges the Gandirosha and Zirramunis ancestry of the protector family shared with Clarahmizah.

sections.title: Earth assignments are a family tradition rather than a separate species or caste. Members can refuse, change careers, remain on Aza'ra
sections.text: Earth assignments are a family tradition rather than a separate species or caste. Members can refuse, change careers, remain on Aza'ra or question whether secrecy and intervention are ethical.

sections.title: 04. THE PRESERVATION OF EARTH'S LOST KNOWLEDGE
sections.text: 04. THE PRESERVATION OF EARTH'S LOST KNOWLEDGE

sections.title: Aza'raan protector families are responsible for the survival of the Library of Alexandria's knowledge in this fictional history. When w
sections.text: Aza'raan protector families are responsible for the survival of the Library of Alexandria's knowledge in this fictional history. When wars, disasters, political repression or pillaging threatened collections, they moved manuscripts, copied works, secured archives and carried knowledge through hidden portals. Similar efforts preserved texts from many other libraries and repositories thought lost.

sections.title: The old Aza'ra archive locates the preserved core of Alexandria's holdings in an older IronForge setting. Because that archival kingdom
sections.text: The old Aza'ra archive locates the preserved core of Alexandria's holdings in an older IronForge setting. Because that archival kingdom description may conflict with newer geography and naming, only the preservation itself is locked as current canon. The final location of the hidden collections needs review against the approved map.

sections.title: The keepers distinguish an original manuscript, a reliable copy, a later transcription, a translated text and a reconstructed work. Dis
sections.text: The keepers distinguish an original manuscript, a reliable copy, a later transcription, a translated text and a reconstructed work. Discoveries can transform modern research without implying that every lost scroll survived intact. Custody, consent, preservation and the possibility of returning knowledge to human communities create story conflicts.

sections.title: 05. EARTH LANGUAGES IN AZA'RAAN EDUCATION
sections.text: 05. EARTH LANGUAGES IN AZA'RAAN EDUCATION

sections.title: Every Earth language is included in the university knowledge curriculum on Aza'ra. Coursework covers living languages, historical and e
sections.text: Every Earth language is included in the university knowledge curriculum on Aza'ra. Coursework covers living languages, historical and extinct languages, endangered languages, sign languages, regional varieties and documented reconstructions. Courses use distinct period labels rather than pretending all communities spoke the same form for centuries.

sections.title: Students learn pronunciation, written traditions, syntax, social setting, migration history, translation ethics and cultural context. A
sections.text: Students learn pronunciation, written traditions, syntax, social setting, migration history, translation ethics and cultural context. Aza'raan experts collaborate across departments to build archival dictionaries and descriptive grammars. An unattested or incompletely recorded language is taught with explicit gaps, not fabricated fluency.

sections.title: Earth language education prepares future generations to understand a planet that remains magically tethered to Aza'ra. The universal-ca
sections.text: Earth language education prepares future generations to understand a planet that remains magically tethered to Aza'ra. The universal-catalog rule concerns the institution's mission and course framework, not an unsupported claim that every language has a complete surviving corpus or equally documented textbook.

sections.title: Since the 1351 BCE Cataclysm, Earth and Aza'ra share one underworld. Souls from both worlds enter the same greater passage, whether the
sections.text: Since the 1351 BCE Cataclysm, Earth and Aza'ra share one underworld. Souls from both worlds enter the same greater passage, whether the living recognized magic or not. Death and passage are not ownership rights conferred by the later Veil; the shared underworld predates the Veil's systematic siphoning of Earth's magic.

sections.title: Nyxarion holds the office of God of Death and directs the final crossing with compassion. His wife Volsara, the former mortal Volsarii
sections.text: Nyxarion holds the office of God of Death and directs the final crossing with compassion. His wife Volsara, the former mortal Volsarii who freely accepted demigodhood, oversees peace, transitions and the convergence of mind, body, soul and heart alongside him. The Volsarii carry out the ferrying of souls and retain their own mortal history and successive lives; they are not impersonal rivers of energy.

sections.title: Anubriosh previously held the office of Death, but no longer governs rightful death. His current domains include necromancy and hunting
sections.text: Anubriosh previously held the office of Death, but no longer governs rightful death. His current domains include necromancy and hunting those who survive death. His ambitions may threaten the crossing, but they do not displace Nyxarion or Volsara.

sections.title: 07. THRESHOLDS, MEMORY AND THE JOURNEY AFTER DEATH
sections.text: 07. THRESHOLDS, MEMORY AND THE JOURNEY AFTER DEATH

sections.title: Older documents describe a Veilgate near the City of the Mourned Gods, where living visitors can glimpse the underworld. They also desc
sections.text: Older documents describe a Veilgate near the City of the Mourned Gods, where living visitors can glimpse the underworld. They also describe moving reflections of memory, places of difficult self-reckoning, and places of restorative peace. Preserve these as atmospheric and functional elements while avoiding the older two-realm names drawn from Aramaic.

sections.title: A soul's passage may include arrival, a guided crossing, reflection upon a life, healing, reunion, rest, and other outcomes. Nyxarion a
sections.text: A soul's passage may include arrival, a guided crossing, reflection upon a life, healing, reunion, rest, and other outcomes. Nyxarion and Volsara do not treat grief or difference as moral failings. The full metaphysical rules of reincarnation, dissolution, return and choice remain open where the newest canonical sources do not specify them.

sections.title: A living visitor must pass through protective binding rites. The older manuscripts establish a three-hour limit, with compulsory return
sections.text: A living visitor must pass through protective binding rites. The older manuscripts establish a three-hour limit, with compulsory return as a safeguard. Details of who may open the gate, how time differs in the underworld, and whether all regions use the same ritual remain subject to later approval. Never treat the underworld as an ordinary safe fast-travel zone.

sections.title: 08. HISTORICAL TERMINOLOGY AND NAMING RULES
sections.text: 08. HISTORICAL TERMINOLOGY AND NAMING RULES

sections.title: An outdated archive uses Aramaic-derived names for afterlife regions. Those names are retired from present canon. The working descripti
sections.text: An outdated archive uses Aramaic-derived names for afterlife regions. Those names are retired from present canon. The working descriptions 'realm of reckoning', 'place of peace', and 'memory passage' are English-language functional labels, not final Aza'raan words.

sections.title: Do not invent an Aza'raan translation by modifying an Aramaic word. Any final name must follow the established Aza'raan historical stag
sections.text: Do not invent an Aza'raan translation by modifying an Aramaic word. Any final name must follow the established Aza'raan historical stage, source roots, phonotactics, script evolution, and multilingual contact rules. Maintain Uxrowoiye and Kaʻaheʻanua as the foundation and record later community influences separately.

sections.title: Nyxarion is the current divine name, not an obsolete form used in older deity drafts. Volsara's identity, relationship and domains must
sections.text: Nyxarion is the current divine name, not an obsolete form used in older deity drafts. Volsara's identity, relationship and domains must follow the strict pantheon JSON. Do not copy outdated divine titles or claim that the later Veil created the entire underworld.

sections.title: In 2036, Pix's discoveries may reveal generations of Earth assignments within the family networks connected to his mother, Clarahmizah
sections.text: In 2036, Pix's discoveries may reveal generations of Earth assignments within the family networks connected to his mother, Clarahmizah and other protectors. The reveal must respect the already planned novel scenes and not transform the protectors into omniscient controllers of human history.

sections.title: The preservation of lost libraries gives the series archives, translated accounts, scientific notebooks and records of cultural contact
sections.text: The preservation of lost libraries gives the series archives, translated accounts, scientific notebooks and records of cultural contact. These provide optional routes to established mysteries, including the search in The Drowned Queen, without inventing new sacred sites or changing Bilqis's chronology.

sections.title: Aza'raan medical and technological interventions can show both genuine compassion and complicated consequences. A protector may face di
sections.text: Aza'raan medical and technological interventions can show both genuine compassion and complicated consequences. A protector may face dilemmas about admitting what a family knows, making an intervention public, or returning a text to its descendants.

sections.title: Historical Belavadös campaigns may depict early transworld scholarship and protected archives only when the chosen year permits them. T
sections.text: Historical Belavadös campaigns may depict early transworld scholarship and protected archives only when the chosen year permits them. The Galaxy Era remains its own alternate timeline and does not need to center Bilqis or turn her Earth clues into compulsory campaign objectives.

sections.title: Use research, medicine, language training, archival conservation and engineering as legitimate career paths. A player may negotiate acc
sections.text: Use research, medicine, language training, archival conservation and engineering as legitimate career paths. A player may negotiate access to a collection, translate damaged text, repair a device, assist a hospital or challenge an unjust secrecy policy. The historical record is preserved without turning ethical controversies into automatic rewards for deception.

sections.title: In the post-apocalyptic MMORPG, survivors may recover references to Earth courses and formerly hidden archives, but the game must not p
sections.text: In the post-apocalyptic MMORPG, survivors may recover references to Earth courses and formerly hidden archives, but the game must not place a living community on destroyed Belavadös. Underworld visits, when developed, should require guided access and explicit safety restrictions.

sections.title: 11. SOURCE RECONCILIATION AND PENDING DECISIONS
sections.text: 11. SOURCE RECONCILIATION AND PENDING DECISIONS

sections.title: Current user canon: family missions to Earth, guilt and responsibility, mixed-heritage human-passing lineages, preservation of Alexandr
sections.text: Current user canon: family missions to Earth, guilt and responsibility, mixed-heritage human-passing lineages, preservation of Alexandria and other libraries, university coursework for every Earth language, one shared underworld since 1351 BCE, and Nyxarion with Volsara as its divine authorities.

sections.title: Supported legacy motifs: Veilgate, City of the Mourned Gods, a protective three-hour mortal visit, memory/reflection imagery, healing a
sections.text: Supported legacy motifs: Veilgate, City of the Mourned Gods, a protective three-hour mortal visit, memory/reflection imagery, healing and reckoning regions, and core Alexandria archives retained on Aza'ra. The details appear in the old MMORPG guide, old Aza'raan dictionary and manuscript drafts. Names and deity governance from these legacy files are superseded.

sections.title: Pending further author approval: the modern Aza'raan names of individual underworld regions, a detailed afterlife map, specific protect
sections.text: Pending further author approval: the modern Aza'raan names of individual underworld regions, a detailed afterlife map, specific protector family names and missions, locations of each saved Earth library, precise limits of mortal underworld visits, and the rules governing souls' destinations or rebirth.

note: Do not override current AWS author-approved canon. Read historical content with its original context.
